one_line: Cloud communications platform whose REST APIs let developers send messages, make calls, and look up numbers across SMS, voice, video, and more.
auth_notes: Primary auth is Account SID + Auth Token (or scoped API keys); OAuth2 available for some APIs. Self-serve signup at twilio.com/console.
self_serve_notes: Free self-serve trial with credit; real usage requires a paid/verified account. No sales gate.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Hundreds of endpoints across Messaging, Voice, Video, Verify, Lookup, Conversations, and more; each product has its own API.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks central to Twilio (message status callbacks, voice callbacks, phone-number events).

existing_mcp.note: Official Twilio MCP server exists; multiple community MCP servers available.

evidence.note: Fetched text (022_twilio.txt) confirms REST organization and per-product APIs. Auth details from knowledge.

agent_notes: Fetched text confirms REST broadly; auth method and MCP evidence from knowledge.
